title: Incoming inspection
online: Needs the network: it is recorded at once.
notYours: This inspection is recorded and signed by the inspector who took it.
notOpen: This inspection is signed or cancelled: it no longer changes.

noPermission.title: Not yours to inspect
noPermission.body: Incoming inspection needs the incoming inspector's right. Ask your team leader or quality.

lot.label: Scan the lot
lot.hint: The lot's label, the supplier's lot, the dye batch, a hide's tag or an inspection number

camera.error: The camera does not start: type the code.

scan.offline: Offline: an inspection this tablet read in this visit opens from it; a new one opens when the network is back.

wrong.notFound: Nothing at this site has the code {code}.
wrong.typo: {code} was misread: scan it again or type it.
wrong.notOnTablet: {code} is not on this tablet: it opens when the network is back.
wrong.otherBench: {code} belongs to another bench: scan a lot, a hide or an incoming inspection.
wrong.nothing: Nothing to inspect for {code}: no incoming plan applies, or the lot is decided. The office names the plan or opens it.
wrong.label: {code} is a label this bench does not take: scan the lot's label.
wrong.notOfLot: {code} is not a hide of this lot.
wrong.notWhole: {code} is cut already: the sample takes whole hides only.
wrong.sampleFull: The sample is full: take a hide out before {code} goes in.
wrong.rollFull: The sample's rolls are all recorded: {code} does not go in.
wrong.notRollLot: {code} is a roll's tag: scan its lot's label first.

open.title: Open at this site
open.none: No incoming inspection is open at this site.
open.failed: The open inspections could not be read: scan the lot all the same.

choose.title: {code} leads to more than one inspection
choose.held: Not this bench's: open it where it is inspected.

result.passing: Accepts up to {major} with a major defect and {minor} with a minor one; a critical defect is never accepted.

over.CRITICAL_one: 1 with a critical defect: a critical defect is never accepted.
over.CRITICAL_other: {count} with a critical defect: a critical defect is never accepted.
over.MAJOR_one: 1 with a major defect: the plan accepts {accept}.
over.MAJOR_other: {count} with a major defect: the plan accepts {accept}.
over.MINOR_one: 1 with a minor defect: the plan accepts {accept}.
over.MINOR_other: {count} with a minor defect: the plan accepts {accept}.

hides.scanHint: A hide's tag (or the tannery's number typed)
hides.lotArea_one: Area of the hide measured: {percent} against the tannery's (tolerance {tolerance} %).
hides.lotArea_other: Area of the {count} hides measured: {percent} against the tannery's (tolerance {tolerance} %).
hides.claim: The office opens the claim for the area.
hides.none: No hide in the sample yet: scan the first one.
hides.candidates_one: 1 whole hide of the lot not inspected
hides.candidates_other: {count} whole hides of the lot not inspected

decision.hint: Accepted, rejected and to sort add up to the lot of {lot} {unit}.
decision.ready: Ready to sign: your PIN signs it.
decision.workshopHint: Goods back from a workshop are decided bundle by bundle: tap a bundle to reject it. Its pieces are rejected; the others go on.

area.notMeasured: Not measured: the area received stands
area.title: Area of {code}

hide.mapRow: Defects and zones on the hide map
hide.remove: Take it out of the sample
hide.offline: Offline: a hide is saved on this tablet and sent when the network is back.

map.title: Hide map of {code}
map.noGrades: No leather grades are set: quality sets them.
map.noDefects: No hide defect in the library: quality sets them.
map.closeHeld_one: Tap at least 3 points of the outline: 1 so far.
map.closeHeld_other: Tap at least 3 points of the outline: {count} so far.
map.tapZone_one: Tap the outline of zone {zone}: 1 point so far.
map.tapZone_other: Tap the outline of zone {zone}: {count} points so far.

held.pickDefect: Pick the defect first, then tap where it is.
held.pickZone: Pick the grade first, then tap its outline.
held.full: At most 60 marks on one hide.
held.outlineFull: At most 60 points in a zone: close it.

map.zoomBottom: The whole hide is on screen
map.noMarks: No mark yet: a hide with no defect is accepted as it is.

roll.per100Unknown: points per 100 sq yd: measure width and length
roll.per100Within: points per 100 sq yd · within the limit of {limit}
roll.per100Over: points per 100 sq yd · over the limit of {limit}: reject suggested

counter.hint: Units of the sample of {sample} with a defect, by class (a unit counts once, under its worst defect).
counter.criticalHint: A critical defect is never accepted

rolls.scanHint: Or type the supplier's roll number
rolls.summary_one: 1 roll · {length} m · {per100} points per 100 sq yd (limit {limit}).
rolls.summary_other: {count} rolls · {length} m · {per100} points per 100 sq yd (limit {limit}).
rolls.meta: {width} cm × {length} m · {points} points · {per100} per 100 sq yd
rolls.candidates_one: 1 tagged roll of the lot not inspected
rolls.candidates_other: {count} tagged rolls of the lot not inspected

components.hint: Each line: what it is, a protector's type and certificate, the pieces looked at and those not right.

reason.noCertificate: Without an EN 1621 certificate a protector goes into no PPE garment.
reason.marking: Read the marking: standard, level, type.
reason.noType: Say the type, A or B, as marked.

held.checked: Say how many pieces were looked at.

checks.office: {check}: answered in the office (no typing on the floor).

held.waiting_one: 1 write of this inspection is still on this tablet: it is sent first.
held.waiting_other: {count} writes of this inspection are still on this tablet: they are sent first.
held.whole: The lot is counted in whole units: whole numbers.
held.sum: They add up to {sum}; the lot is {lot}.
held.hidesUndecided_other: Decide every hide of the sample first: {codes}.
held.rollsUndecided_one: Decide the roll with no decision first.
held.rollsUndecided_other: Decide every roll first: {count} have no decision.
held.componentsUndecided_one: Decide the component line with no decision first.
held.componentsUndecided_other: Decide every component line first: {count} have no decision.

below.accepted: The sample accepted more: at least {min}.
below.rejected: The sample rejected more: at least {min}.
below.toSort: The sample left more to sort: at least {min}.

held.outsideBeforeWhole: Inspect the whole sample first ({done} of {sample}) before accepting hides outside it; reject or sort the rest now.
held.outsideBeforeWholeRolls: Inspect every roll of the sample first ({done} of {sample}) before accepting more than the rolls accepted; reject or sort the rest.
held.failedSplit: The sample fails: accept only the {accepted} inspected and accepted; reject or sort the rest.
held.hard: Never the whole lot: a critical defect or a failed critical check.
held.mandatory_one: Answer the required check before accepting the whole lot.
held.mandatory_other: Answer the {count} required checks before accepting the whole lot.

override.FAIL: The rules say it fails: accepting the whole lot over them needs written reasons, so the office does it.
override.PASS: The rules say it passes: rejecting the whole lot over them needs written reasons, so the office does it.

held.workshopSort: Goods back from a workshop leave nothing to sort.
held.notYours: Only the inspector who took it signs it.

sign.title: Sign the decision
sign.meaning: I sign incoming inspection {number} of {lot}: accepted {accepted}, rejected {rejected}, to sort {toSort}.

done.title: {number} signed

next.RELEASE: Lot {lot} stays in quarantine until a person with the quality role types its code and releases it.
next.REJECT: Lot {lot} stays in quarantine: a person with the quality role rejects it, and purchasing returns it to the supplier.
next.SORT: What is to sort is inspected unit by unit in a new inspection of lot {lot} before it is released.
next.RELEASE_PART: The office holds or returns the rejected units; then a person with the quality role releases lot {lot}.

done.workshop_one: 1 bundle rejected ({bundles}): not reported at the operation. Rework it or send it back to the workshop; the others go on and into the workshop's fee.
done.workshop_other: {count} bundles rejected ({bundles}): not reported at the operation. Rework them or send them back to the workshop; the others go on and into the workshop's fee.
done.workshopAll: Every bundle goes on to the next operation and into the workshop's fee.

doneLine.hideRemoved: Hide {code} is out of the sample.

OTHER_BENCH.message: This code belongs to another bench.
OTHER_BENCH.fix: Scan a lot, a hide or an incoming inspection here.

NOTHING_TO_INSPECT.message: Nothing to inspect for this code.
NOTHING_TO_INSPECT.fix: No incoming plan applies, or the lot is decided: the office names the plan or opens it.

CHOOSE.message: This code leads to more than one inspection.
CHOOSE.fix: Open the one you inspect from the list.

LABEL.message: This label is not one this bench takes.

FLOOR_NOT_READY.message: This tablet is not ready for inspections.
FLOOR_NOT_READY.fix: Ask the office to set it up.

other.message: The office did not take it.
other.fix: Read the inspection again; ask quality if it stays.
